# Commercial Lease Agreement

- **Document date**: April 1, 2025 (src: 2025-04-01-lease-harborview)
- **Landlord**: Harborview Properties LLC, 900 Quay Street, Portside (src: 2025-04-01-lease-harborview)
- **Tenant**: Northwind Repair LLC, a single-member limited liability company (Sam Rivera, Member) (src: 2025-04-01-lease-harborview)
- **Premises**: 1480 Harbor Avenue, Suite 210, Portside; approx. 850 sq ft, ground floor workshop and office (src: 2025-04-01-lease-harborview)
- **Term**: Twenty-four (24) months commencing 2025-04-01 and ending 2027-03-31 (src: 2025-04-01-lease-harborview)
- **Rent**: $1,450.00 per month, due on the 1st; late after the 5th (late fee $75) (src: 2025-04-01-lease-harborview)
- **Security deposit**: $2,900.00, held by Landlord (src: 2025-04-01-lease-harborview)
- **Renewal and notice**: Lease renews for one further 12-month term on the same terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days before the end of the term (src: 2025-04-01-lease-harborview)
- **Use**: Appliance repair workshop, parts storage, customer drop-off. No vehicle repair (src: 2025-04-01-lease-harborview)
- **Insurance**: Tenant shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence naming Landlord as additional insured (src: 2025-04-01-lease-harborview)

Signed March 18, 2025:

/s/ Dana Okafor, Manager, Harborview Properties LLC (src: 2025-04-01-lease-harborview)
/s/ Sam Rivera, Member, Northwind Repair LLC (src: 2025-04-01-lease-harborview)
